Spec overlays that work: none: it already has full metal; a gloss clearcoat spec for extra depth
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

examples.title: Ask for it by name
examples.goal: See Spider Web on the car.

settings.AI copilot (✦ AI button): put Spider Web on the hood
